title: 第1466章 故人尚在第1465章 回归
slug: 投资天命族人我实力是全族总和
content_zh:
鸿愣了一下。
“你怎么知道？”
姜道玄笑而不语。
倘若鸿从上一任天墟意志那里得到完整传承，那么就必将继承所有记忆。
自然也就能清楚一亿年前发生的那些事情。
可看着对方的反应，却一点没有往那个方向去想，显然是记忆缺失所导致。
不过想想也是，一亿年的岁月太过漫长，漫长到天墟意志或许都已更迭数次，有所缺失亦是情理之中。
此刻，鸿并不知道姜道玄在想什么。
见他不愿解释，虽然仍有疑惑，却也没有继续追问。
很快，他的注意力便重新落回对方身上。
认真打量片刻后，鸿有些好奇道：
“不过……比起你去了哪里，我觉得你身上的变化更奇怪。”
他身为天墟意志，对这方界域中的一切都极为敏锐。
无论是生灵体内的道则，还是其与天墟本源之间的联系，都很难逃过他的感知。
可如今，站在姜道玄面前，他惊愕发现自己竟有些看不透对方。
“哦？”
姜道玄看了过来。
鸿面露迟疑：“怎么说呢，以前的你虽然很强，但依旧属于天墟，现在却像是……无论身处何地，都不会再受到任何界域束缚。”
姜道玄对此并不意外。
人道领域的生灵，无论修为多高，终究都要依托界域而存在。

他们修炼天地法则，借助世界本源证道，即便是极道大帝，也无法脱离孕育自身的天地。
可红尘仙不同。
其仙道根基源于自身。
长生物质亦由体内诞生。
证道红尘仙的那一刻，便意味着生命层次已经真正超脱人道领域，不再受限于某一方界域。
天墟能够承载他，却再也无法束缚他。
姜道玄淡淡说道：
“你感觉到的并没有错，如今的我，已经不再属于任何一方界域。”
鸿微微一怔。
旋即意识到什么，惊讶道：
“你突破了？”
姜道玄微微颔首。
“侥幸走出了那一步。”
鸿盯着他看了片刻。
随后，脸上的惊讶逐渐化作笑意。
“能平安回来，还踏出了那一步……的确很好。”
他没有追问对方究竟经历了什么。
对鸿而言，只要这个朋友平安归来，而且变得比从前更加强大，便已经足够了。
姜道玄微微一笑。
片刻后，他忽然问道：

“这四年里，天墟可曾发生什么大事？”
鸿摇了摇头。
“一切如常，道盟仍在维持五方界群的秩序，各处也没有出现太大的动乱，你不必担心。”
说到这里，他顿了顿。
“不过，最近倒是有两件事，你或许会感兴趣。”
content_en:
Hong was stunned for a moment.
"How do you know?"
Jiang Daoxuan smiled and said nothing.
If Hong gets a complete inheritance from the previous Tianxu will, then he will definitely inherit all the memories.
Naturally, we can understand what happened 100 million years ago.
But looking at the other party's reaction, he didn't think in that direction at all. It was obviously caused by memory loss.
But think about it, one hundred million years is too long, so long that the will of Tianxu may have changed several times, so it is reasonable to have some shortcomings.
At this moment, Hong didn't know what Jiang Daoxuan was thinking.
Seeing that he was unwilling to explain, although he still had doubts, he did not continue to ask.
Soon, his attention returned to the other person.
After looking at it carefully for a moment, Hong said curiously:
"But...compared to where you went, I think the changes in you are stranger."
As the will of Tianxu, he is extremely sensitive to everything in this realm.
Whether it is the Tao in the body of a living being or its connection with the origin of Tianxu, it is difficult to escape his perception.
But now, standing in front of Jiang Daoxuan, he was shocked to find that he could not see through him.
"Oh?"
Jiang Daoxuan looked over.
Hong looked hesitant: "How should I put it? Although you were very strong in the past, you still belonged to Tianxu, but now it seems that... no matter where you are, you will no longer be bound by any realm."
Jiang Daoxuan was not surprised by this.
Creatures in the human realm, no matter how high their cultivation level, must ultimately rely on the realm to exist.
They practice the laws of heaven and earth and use the origin of the world to prove the Tao. Even the Great Emperor of the Great Dao cannot escape from the heaven and earth that gave birth to themselves.
But Hongchenxian is different.
The foundation of his immortality comes from himself.
Immortal substances are also born from within the body.
The moment you become a human being, it means that your life level has truly transcended the realm of humanity and is no longer limited to a certain realm.
Tianxu can carry him, but it can no longer restrain him.
Jiang Daoxuan said lightly:
"What you feel is not wrong. Now I no longer belong to any realm."
Hong was slightly startled.
Immediately he realized something and said in surprise:
"Did you break through?"
Jiang Daoxuan nodded slightly.
"I was lucky enough to take that step."
Hong stared at him for a moment.
Then, the surprise on his face gradually turned into a smile.
"It's really good to be able to come back safely and take that step..."
He did not ask what the other person had experienced.
For Hong, it was enough as long as this friend returned safely and became stronger than before.
Jiang Daoxuan smiled slightly.
After a moment, he suddenly asked:
"Have any major events happened in Tianxu in the past four years?"
Hong shook his head.
"Everything is as usual, the Taoist Alliance is still maintaining the order of the Five Realms Group, and there is no major turmoil anywhere. You don't have to worry."
At this point, he paused.
"However, there are two things recently that may interest you."
